risk_summary: The excerpt provides meaningful quantitative disclosure on revenue declines, segment performance, liquidity, restructuring costs, and expected savings. However, extensive safe-h harbor language and repeated broad references to uncertain macroeconomic, geopolitical, supply-chain, and demand risks reduce specificity regarding downside scenarios. Kodak faces pressured print volumes, higher costs, constrained manufacturing capacity, and reliance on uncertain trade-relief outcomes, partially mitigated by pricing, cost reductions, and reported liquidity.
